evidence_tree.command: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
evidence_tree.note: The golden scenario's own input tuple (items, AP, target resistances, fight window) is defined outside the exported tree, so the total was not reconstructible end-to-end. The CHANGE (the delta) is reconstructible exactly, and that is what this receipt adjudicates.

sources_quoted.quote: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.
At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.
Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.
values [7,7,7,7,7], affectedByCdr: false  (a single-charge Q cannot recast inside a burst window; a second Dark Sphere in one rotation can only come from the 40-splinter charge)

sources_quoted.source: docs/math-foundations.md, Section 5 formula-audit table, row 'Stat rounding (calculate_total_stats)'
sources_quoted.quote: display-level integer rounding of health/AD/AP/armor/MR before damage ... corpus-wide convention, pinned by golden

Multi-hit abilities. A part with `h` identical hits is mitigated per hit and summed: `sum_h m(R)*raw = h*m(R)*raw` ... exact because the mitigation operator `x -> x*100/(100+R)` is linear in raw damage for a fixed resistance
E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage), R sphere count (r_spheres).

independent_computation.step_1_delta: 6185.5 - 5472.5 = 713.0 exactly. Both endpoints carry one decimal, so the delta is exact to 0.1.
independent_computation.step_2_identify_the_added_term: Section 5 of math-foundations pins AP to an INTEGER before damage ('display-level integer rounding of ... AP ... before damage'). Solving flat + ratio*AP = 713.0 for every Syndra damage term at max ranks, under the integer-AP rule and the 15% Transcendence multiplier that is active at 120 splinters:

candidate_table.status: SURVIVES - both AP values are exact round integers
rejected (no round pre-buff AP; rank 4 Q at level 18 is off-pattern)
rejected (no round pre-buff AP, and no sourced mechanic gives E a second cast in one rotation)
rejected (absurd AP; also non-terminating at plausible AP)

independent_computation.step_3_unique_fit: Exactly one candidate closes with round numbers on both sides of the Transcendence multiplier: 230 + 0.70 * 690 = 161 + ... => 230 + 483 = 713.0, with 690 = 600 * 1.15 exactly (Transcendence at 120 Splinters applied to a 600 AP build, then integer-rounded to 690). Every other candidate needs a non-integer AP (violating the pinned rounding rule) or a non-round pre-buff AP.
independent_computation.step_4_mechanism: The added term is therefore ONE additional rank-5 Dark Sphere instance at the Transcendent-buffed 690 AP. The wiki text gives exactly one mechanism for a second Dark Sphere inside a single rotation: 'Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.' At 120 Splinters that threshold is passed (as are 60/80/100), so a correct 120-splinter rotation must fire TWO Dark Spheres, not one. Q's own cooldown (7 s, affectedByCdr false) cannot supply a second cast in a burst window, so the charge is the only sourced source.
independent_computation.step_5_delta_is_unmitigated: The delta equals the raw ability value with no mitigation factor applied (713.0 exactly, not m*713). This is consistent with the manual target carrying 0 effective magic resistance after penetration, or with the leaf being pre-mitigation; either way the mitigation operator is linear in raw damage (math-foundations Sec. 1.2), so the identification of the added term is unaffected.
independent_computation.step_6_residual_check: Everything other than the one Dark Sphere is identical between the two runs: old - new differs by a single ability instance and nothing else. Subtracting a plausible 120-splinter core (Q + W magic 638.5 + W true 164.733 + E 614 + R 7 spheres 2086 at AP 690) leaves the SAME residual 1256.27 in both the old and the new total, confirming that no other term moved.

alternative_hypotheses_rejected.hypothesis: The change toggled the 120-splinter +15% total-AP buff on (old = unbuffed, new = buffed).
alternative_hypotheses_rejected.test: delta = f(1.15*A) - f(A) with f = B + c*A + d*A^2 (d = W's quadratic true-damage term), scanning integer AP that stays integer after the 1.15 multiplier and every achievable AP-coefficient sum c (multiples of 0.05) and W-cast count 0..4.
alternative_hypotheses_rejected.result: No combination reproduces 713.000; only 7 fits reach 713.0 after rounding, each demanding an implausible pair (e.g. AP 980 with c = 4.85 and zero W casts, or AP 400 with c = 11.2). The Dark-Sphere hypothesis by contrast is exact to the last digit.
alternative_hypotheses_rejected.additional_reason: The scenario id pins splinters = 120 as a fixed INPUT in both runs, so the Transcendence buff is not the variable under test.

alternative_hypotheses_rejected.hypothesis: The change enabled the 60-splinter W bonus true damage.
alternative_hypotheses_rejected.test: (0.12 + 0.0002*AP) * (190 + 0.65*AP) = 713 requires AP ~ 1901 for one W cast; integer-count multiples give no round AP either.

alternative_hypotheses_rejected.hypothesis: The change added R spheres (r_spheres option).
alternative_hypotheses_rejected.test: Every sphere count 1..4 requires a non-integer or absurd AP (see candidate table).

alternative_hypotheses_rejected.hypothesis: The new value over-counts by adding a THIRD Dark Sphere (beyond the max of 2 charges).
alternative_hypotheses_rejected.assessment: Not excludable from the exported tree alone, since the absolute cast counts are not reconstructible without the scenario's input tuple. It is however the less likely reading: the scenario is a custom-cast-order test at exactly the splinter count that grants the second charge, and the delta is one charge's worth. Flagged as the one residual uncertainty in this receipt.

conclusion: The change adds exactly one rank-5 Dark Sphere (230 + 70% AP) evaluated at 690 AP, i.e. 600 AP raised by the 120-splinter Transcendence multiplier (600 * 1.15 = 690, 230 + 0.70*690 = 713.0). The League Wiki cache states that at 40+ Splinters of Wrath Syndra stocks a second Dark Sphere charge (max 2), and a scenario pinned at 120 splinters is far past that threshold, so a 120-splinter rotation must contain two Dark Spheres. The old value contained one; the new value contains two. The higher value is the sourced-correct one.
